name: Material Movement Item
description: One catalogued item on one gate movement: what it is, how much of it, what condition it arrived in, and the serial it carries. Keyed on row_uuid so a retried save updates the row it created rather than adding a second one.

fields.label: Row UUID
fields.description: Client-generated idempotency key. The server upserts on this, never on row position.

fields.label: Item Name
fields.description: Denormalised at write time, so the row still reads correctly if the master is later renamed.

fields.label: Expected Qty
fields.description: Sheet quantity per bus. A hint that pre-fills the box - never a limit.

fields.label: Item Carries a QR
fields.description: Copied from the item master at capture time.

fields.label: QR Source
fields.description: An audit cares which. A typed serial is a claim; a scanned one is a reading.

fields.label: Used For (Chassis)
fields.description: Which bus this part is going into. Free text: a chassis at the plant often has no record yet.

fields.label: Reason for No Photo
fields.options:
Sealed packaging
Poor light
Camera unavailable
Bulk item
Other
